title: 翠嶺の遺言、あるいは落葉の譜
author: 森閑 イオリ

en.title: Testament of the Verdant Ridge, or a Chronicle of Fallen Leaves
en.premise: What I inherited from my mentor was a single, weathered plant observation notebook and a small mountain villa nestled within a deep forest. There, I discovered quiet festival nights that unfold with the shifting seasons. The 'testament' my mentor left behind was not a matter of monetary wealth, but the commitment to continue the observations—to accurately decipher the forest's subtle changes and pass them on to the next generation. Following in those footsteps, I begin to live a gentle life in harmony with the forest.

zh.title: 翠岭的遗言，或是落叶之谱
zh.premise: 从恩师那里继承下来的，是一本陈旧的植物观察笔记和一座被深林环绕的小山庄。在那里，有着随着季节更迭而举行的宁静祭典之夜。恩师留下的“遗言”，并非金钱财富，而是要通过持续的观察，准确解读森林的细微变化，并将其传承给下一代。循着那些记录，我开始过上人与森林共生的恬静日常。

prediction_results.question: 蔵本に連れ戻された二人は、アオノツガザクラの群生地について何を言い渡されるのか？

森の過酷な歴史を語られる
